entities.summary: Quinton Robert Hosley is an American-born naturalized Georgian professional basketball player for Stelmet Zielona Góra of the Polish Basketball League. He is a 2.01 m tall swingman. He is the son of streetball and Rucker Park legend Ron Mathias.
